entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and the letter's writer, who fled New Phyrexia's Mirrodin after the failed final stand and woke wounded in a temple on Theros.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker, the addressee of Elspeth's letter, who has wandered the planes longer than she and once told her planeswalking would hurt less.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A man immune to the Phyrexian contagion who fought beside Elspeth in the Mirran resistance, set the spellbomb and sealed her away from the chamber.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A young Mirran who provided natural immunity to the Phyrexian contagion; Elspeth was separated from her before the final stand.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker whose schematics improved the spellbomb and who was building a Phyrexian-inspired ship; Koth forced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin, and he has since died.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Mirrodin's creator, in whose days the secret chamber was used for special executions and after whose departure the resistance briefly hoped.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An interloper the praetors despise, expected at the gathering of praetors.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A praetor who dominated other praetors' domains and preached suturing dissenters into the orthodoxy.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor, one of the gods of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor, one of the gods of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A praetor whose domain Elesh Norn was believed to have dominated.

entities.name: The praetors
entities.description: The Phyrexian rulers of New Phyrexia, gathering to choose a new Father or Mother of Machines.

entities.name: Obliterator
entities.description: A Phyrexian abomination designed solely to kill, which struck down Elspeth in the chamber.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god of the sun on Theros, whose star-like form Elspeth saw the day she got her sword.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A god of Theros, of potions and poison, to whom prayers are sunk in swamps.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods where Elspeth got her sword and now recovers in a temple.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane engulfed by Phyrexia, where the resistance made its final stand.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading power that engulfed Mirrodin and spreads by contagion.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A plane where Koth encased Venser's head in rock and where Koth later saw Ajani.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: Butcher Hall
entities.description: A hall crossed to reach the secret chamber in the Phyrexian cathedral-fortress.

events.summary: Elspeth, hurt and in a swamp-side cave temple on Theros, is cared for by snake-loving priests and writes a letter to Ajani that she knows he will never read.
events.quote: I'm writing you this letter knowing that you'll never read it.

events.summary: Elspeth arrives on Theros in a bleak swamp near a cave temple where priests care for her.
events.quote: When I arrived this time, I ended up in a bleak swamp near an entrance to a cave.

events.summary: Phyrexia rears up and engulfs Mirrodin, and Melira provides a natural immunity to the contagion.
events.quote: You know that Phyrexia reared up and engulfed the metal plane.

events.summary: After Karn leaves, the resistance briefly hopes as the praetors squabble; they then focus on destroying Elesh Norn, but are slaughtered in far greater numbers.
events.quote: But for every life we saved, they slaughtered eight, ten, a hundred more.

events.summary: The resistance is lost and Elspeth and Koth prepare their final stand.
events.quote: The resistance was lost. We reached the finale—the night of our final stand.

events.summary: Elspeth and Koth, separated from Melira, infiltrate the Phyrexian cathedral-fortress and cross Butcher Hall to a secret chamber.
events.quote: Koth and I managed to infiltrate their cathedral-fortress and navigate that warren of death and madness.

events.summary: Koth carries a spellbomb, modified with Venser's schematics, into the chamber beneath the new throne room.
events.quote: We'd modified it using Venser's schematics.

events.summary: They learn that the praetors are gathering to select a new Father or Mother of Machines, making it their last chance to hurt them.
events.quote: We'd learned that the praetors were gathering in the throne room to select a new Father—or Mother—of Machines.

events.summary: The Phyrexians find them despite the sealed door, and Koth sets the spellbomb.
Koth tells Elspeth she is leaving and that there is nothing to come back for.
events.quote: Seal this world off, and throw away the key.

events.summary: Flashback: on Urborg, Koth encased Venser's head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.
events.quote: He encased his head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.

events.summary: Koth sinks Elspeth up to her knees in stone and raises a wall between them to shield her from the spellbomb.
events.quote: Now it was my turn, but he just sunk me up to my knees in the stone and left me there.

events.summary: The door explodes and an Obliterator enters before Elspeth can planeswalk.
events.quote: An Obliterator lurched into the chamber.

events.summary: The Obliterator drives two blades into Elspeth's belly as Koth's spellbomb explodes beyond the wall.
events.quote: I didn't even raise my sword before two of its blades drove deep into my belly.

events.summary: Elspeth planeswalks away through the Blind Eternities, bleeding, thinking of the divine.
events.quote: My blood rushed out of me as I left that nightmare world.

events.summary: Elspeth resolves to stay in the cave until she understands Theros and its gods.
events.quote: I am resolved to stay here until I understand the nature of the world and its divine stewards.

relations.note: They fought together in the resistance and made a pact.
relations.quote: Koth and I managed to infiltrate their cathedral-fortress and navigate that warren of death and madness.

relations.note: Elspeth writes to him as a trusted friend.
relations.quote: When you look at me, you see all that I could be.

relations.note: Koth forced Venser to planeswalk to Mirrodin to stop his Phyrexian ship.
relations.quote: He encased his head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.

relations.note: It is a brainchild of the contagion.
relations.quote: This is a brainchild of the contagion—an abomination designed solely to kill.

relations.note: A god of Theros, of potions and poison.
relations.quote: That's what you do with prayers here, or at least prayers to Pharika, who seems to be the god of potions.

relations.note: She saw him the day she got her sword.
relations.quote: I saw him the day I got my sword.
